name: Ethni
overview: Ethni was a male descendant of the tribe of Levi, specifically identified as the son of Zerah. He is associated with the Gershonite line, which traces back to Gershon, a son of Levi. This places Ethni within the Levitical family responsible for specific religious duties in Israel.
namesAndTitles: The name Ethni means 'gift or hire,' reflecting a proper name of Hebrew origin. There is no indication that this name was given directly by God, but it carries a meaning that may suggest a role or value attributed to him within his community.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Ethni as the son of Zerah and infers Malchijah as his father. Beyond these relationships, no additional family connections are documented in the biblical record.
scriptureSignificance: Ethni's significance lies in his place within the Levitical genealogy, particularly among the Gershonites, who were entrusted with important responsibilities in the tabernacle service. His lineage underscores the continuity of the Levitical priestly heritage and the ordered structure God established for worship in Israel.
